proposals.evidence: Turner directly gives Lahnda/Punjabi tusĩ/tusī̃, Multani tussã, Dogri-region tus and Maiya/Chilisso/Gowro tus under yuṣmad, with t- influenced by tuvam. These matching plural/honorific survey forms belong to that specifically attested family, with their elicited register preserved.

proposals.evidence: Turner directly attests tu/tū/tū̃ throughout the relevant Indo-Aryan languages under tuvam. These remaining unmixed survey pronouns include broader plural elicitation labels; they remain lexical tu forms, without pretending that every recorded register is inherited from the ancient singular usage.
